mapper.insert: insert into review_attempts ( user_id, review_card_id, review_cycle_id, review_cycle_question_id, user_answer_id, attempt_source, result, sm2_quality, target_error_resolved, ai_feedback, ease_factor_after, repetition_count_after, interval_days_after, cycle_success_count_after, next_due_at, created_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{reviewCardId}, #{reviewCycleId}, #{reviewCycleQuestionId}, #{userAnswerId}, #{attemptSource}, #{result}, #{sm2Quality}, #{targetErrorResolved}, #{aiFeedback}, #{easeFactorAfter}, #{repetitionCountAfter}, #{intervalDaysAfter}, #{cycleSuccessCountAfter}, #{nextDueAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: select attempt.id, cycle.cycle_no, cycle_question.question_role, question.source_text, ( select answer.answer_text from question_answers answer where answer.question_id = question.id and answer.deleted = false order by case when answer.primary_answer = true then 0 else 1 end, answer.sort_order asc, answer.id asc limit 1 ) as reference_answer, user_answer.answer_text, attempt.result, user_answer.total_score, attempt.sm2_quality as quality, attempt.created_at from review_attempts attempt inner join review_cycles cycle on cycle.id = attempt.review_cycle_id and cycle.review_card_id = attempt.review_card_id inner join review_cycle_questions cycle_question on cycle_question.id = attempt.review_cycle_question_id and cycle_question.review_cycle_id = attempt.review_cycle_id inner join user_answers user_answer on user_answer.id = attempt.user_answer_id and user_answer.user_id = attempt.user_id and user_answer.deleted = false inner join questions question on question.id = user_answer.question_id and question.deleted = false where attempt.review_card_id = #{reviewCardId} and attempt.user_id = #{userId} and attempt.attempt_source = 'REVIEW' order by attempt.created_at desc, attempt.id desc
